description: Read your own account, one section per call. "overview" (default): profile, plan and listing limit, payout wallet, and every listing you own with its status (draft, pending, active, hidden or paused_over_plan_limit), moderator note and views. "balance": USD on hold, being sent, below the crypto payout minimum and paid out, the next release date and past payouts with transaction IDs. "sales": every paid sale of your listings with what you receive and the payout date. "purchases": every order you placed as a buyer, with the delivery once paid. "stats": views, clicks, downloads, sales and earnings for the last 7, 30 or 90 days, per day and per listing. Unpaid and cancelled orders are left out; no pagination. Use get_order for one order. Read-only. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

days.description: Only for section "stats": length of the period ending today, 7, 30 (default) or 90 days. views_previous_period covers the same length just before it.

section.description: What to read: overview (default), balance, sales, purchases or stats

name: get_account
title: My account
